comparison.objective: Palletize boxes into a pinwheel layer; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated box grasping, transport, orientation, and placement versus small-tool insertion, collar tuning, bimanual stabilization, and force-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Completed pinwheel pallet layer is implied; candidate requires two safe dynamic stops and retained adjustment. Placement tolerances and stability rubric are absent.
comparison.reason: Pallet pattern construction does not test damper adjustment or cyclic response.
